g.text: The context path shrinks the patch to 16 × 16 and grows it

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1b2430

g.text: back, so it sees the neighbourhood but every value is blurred.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1b2430

g.text: The per-cell path never shrinks anything, so it stays sharp.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1b2430

g.text: The score is decided by the top ~1,200 cells, where blur fails.
